subject.title: Feature: groupScope option to consolidate group sessions into main

question: Should OpenClaw accept a groupScope-style core config that folds selected group/channel peers into the main session, and what audit/docs/proof gate is required before the linked PR can land?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested config changes transcript trust boundaries and adds core session-routing surface that needs maintainer product and security intent.

options.title: Proceed after gates
options.body: Refresh and review the linked groupScope PR after it has real behavior proof, inbound/outbound session parity, security-audit posture, and docs warnings.

options.title: Narrow the design
options.body: Reject a global group-to-main default for now and sponsor a narrower per-binding or named shared-session contract that limits accidental context sharing.

options.title: Defer to broader tracker
options.body: Keep this issue as context for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/19929 if maintainers decide groupScope should not land independently.

recommendation.title: Proceed after gates
recommendation.body: Refresh and review the linked groupScope PR after it has real behavior proof, inbound/outbound session parity, security-audit posture, and docs warnings.
